name: massage-subscription-monorepo
description: Fullstack monorepo for a massage chain subscription platform.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @massage/shared build && pnpm --filter server build && pnpm --filter client build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @massage/shared build && pnpm --parallel --filter server --filter client dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @massage/shared build && pnpm --filter server build && pnpm --filter client typecheck
